description: This Java class represents an HTTP precondition header 'If-Match' based on EntityTags, providing methods to check if the header meets certain conditions and to extract it from headers.

classes.name: IfMatchPreconditionHeader
classes.description: An immutable Java class representing the HTTP 'If-Match' precondition header, managing EntityTags and condition checks.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the header key string for 'If-Match', aligned with DittoHeaderDefinition.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the entity tags to match, used as the header value.

methods.name: meetsConditionFor
methods.description: Determines if the header condition matches a given EntityTag based on strong matching rules as per RFC7232.

methods.name: fromDittoHeaders
methods.description: Static method to extract an IfMatchPreconditionHeader from DittoHeaders if present.
